rounds.diagnosis: The pour subgoal's height term is too loose: with slack loose the spout tip may finish anywhere from 1 cm to 13 cm above mug.opening_center, so an accepted goal can have the fully tipped spout pouring from well over a decimetre above the rim, splashing or missing the mug. Narrow this band one step (loose -> moderate); it still contains the 7 cm nominal and remains reachable from the 9 cm carry standoff. The remaining rows are adequate: the carry keeps the pot upright with a tight parallel row, and the pour path keeps the lateral axis horizontal while leaving only the tilt itself free.
